V3-H1_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT.name: Compression Channel Breakout
V3-H1_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT.rationale: Enters when volatility is tightly compressed and price initiates a breakout near the 50-bar channel extremes.

V3-H2_ATR_COMPRESSION.name: ATR Squeeze Expansion
V3-H2_ATR_COMPRESSION.rationale: Enters when short-term ATR relative to long-term ATR reaches a local squeeze state (ATR ratio < 1.05) and price moves near boundaries.

V3-H3_MOMENTUM_ACCEL.name: Volatility Slope Breakout
V3-H3_MOMENTUM_ACCEL.rationale: Uses a wider volatility gate but requires directional momentum slope confirmation to initiate entry.
